svg.text: OpenSHMEM PGAS for NVIDIA GPU Clusters - Magnum IO - github.com/NVIDIA/nvshmem - GPU-initiated RMA
L1 - Workloads + Integrations (fine-grained GPU-initiated comm - complement to NCCL collectives)
L2 - OpenSHMEM PGAS Model (PE = GPU process - symmetric heap - one-sided put/get from CUDA kernels)
CUDA kernel / stream / CPU all supported
Remote ptr = local offset + remote heap base
Multi-PE per GPU limited support since 2.4.1
Thread / warp / block scoped device ops
L3 - API Surface (Host + Device + Stream + Teams - OpenSHMEM spec on GPU)
put/get putmem/getmem p/g iput/iget nbi variants
Buffer registration for local non-heap mem
Team creation host-side - query on device
NCCL interoperability API for hybrid apps
MPI PMI UID plugin bootstrap exchange
Exchange heap bases RDMA keys IPC handles
L4 - Symmetric Heap + Memory Management (virtual-memory PGAS - DMA-BUF GDR registration)
Static + dynamic device memory heap kinds
Per-PE symmetric VA space w/ remote mapping
Exchange remote addrs + MR sizes at bootstrap
Direct placement into destination sym buffer
CUDA IPC handles for intra-node P2P path
Python bindings - PyTorch CuPy Numba CuTe
L5 - Plugin Transport Layer (P2P first - remote plugin - optional IBGDA GPU-initiated IB)
nvshmem_transport plugin load - version check - transport bitmap per PE
PCIe distance GPU-NIC mapping - NVSHMEM_REMOTE_TRANSPORT env
L6 - Runtime Internals + Package (src/host/ - src/device/ - modules/transport/ - perftest/ - nvshmem4py/)
Device One-Sided Put+Signal Path (MoE dispatch / DeepEP pattern)
CUDA kernel initiates RMA - no CPU proxy on IBGDA path - signal for fine-grained sync
Step 1: nvshmem_init (MPI/UID bootstrap) - exchange heap bases + transport endpoints
Step 2: nvshmem_malloc symmetric buffers on each PE - register w/ DMA-BUF for NIC GDR
Step 3: __global__ kernel: nvshmem_putmem_nbi_block(dest, src, bytes, pe)
Step 4: putmem_signal_nbi_block data + signal atomic to remote symmetric buffer
Step 5: Remote PE: nvshmem_signal_wait_until - consume data - overlap w/ compute
IBGDA: GPU posts WQE directly - no host proxy - P2P path uses CUDA IPC for intra-node
Non-IBGDA: host proxy thread progresses NET async while GPU kernel waits on fence/quiet
Triton-distributed lowers same primitives via libshmem_device in compiled kernels
Systems building block for GPU-initiated PGAS - complements not replaces NCCL
nvshmem_init - nvshmem_malloc - kernel w/ nvshmem_putmem + signal_wait_until
Design Position (Magnum IO PGAS layer - GPU-initiated one-sided comm for irregular and fused workloads)
Symmetric heap + device RMA + plugin transports + IBGDA = foundation for DeepEP and custom overlap kernels
Init: bootstrap exchange - symmetric heap setup - transport plugin load - GPU-NIC topo map
Loop: device put/get/atomic - signal sync - fence/quiet - device collectives - host proxy if needed
Sources: github.com/NVIDIA/nvshmem - docs.nvidia.com/nvshmem - arXiv 2606.05951 - NVSHMEM 3.0 blog
